description: A monetary amount in a specific currency. Stores amount as an integer count of the currency's ISO 4217 minor unit (e.g. cents for USD) rather than a decimal or float, so amounts compare and sum exactly with no floating-point error. The minor-unit size is NOT carried here -- consumers join `currency` against an ISO 4217 minor-unit table (most currencies: 2; JPY/KRW: 0; BHD/KWD/OMR: 3; MGA/MRU: non-decimal) to interpret or render `amount`.

$kind.description: Optional self-identifier (cf. GraphQL __typename) when this object appears outside a typed parent field — e.g. in a polymorphic collection. Omit when the enclosing schema already names the role (unitPrice, balance, total).

amount.description: Integer amount in the currency's minor unit. May be negative (refunds, debits, ledger entries). Sign and magnitude are unconstrained here -- compose a stricter schema (e.g. minimum: 0) for contexts like a charge that must be positive.

title: Monetary amount
